entries.title: Matthew 10:1
segments: And when He had called to [Him] His twelve disciples, He gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease.

entries.title: Matthew 10:2
segments: And the names of the twelve apostles are these: First, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James [the son] of Zebedee and John his brother;

entries.title: Matthew 10:3
segments: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax-collector; James [the son] of Alpheus, and Lebbeus, whose surname was Thaddeus;

entries.title: Matthew 10:4
segments: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.

entries.title: Matthew 10:5
segments: Jesus sent out these twelve, commanding them, saying, Do not go into the way of the nations, and do not enter into [any] city of [the] Samaritans.

entries.title: Matthew 10:6
segments: But rather go to the lost sheep of [the] house of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 10:7
segments: And as you go, proclaim, saying, The kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

entries.title: Matthew 10:8
segments: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons. You have received freely, freely give.

entries.title: Matthew 10:9
segments: Do not provide gold nor silver, nor copper in your purses,

entries.title: Matthew 10:10
segments: nor a bag for [the] journey, nor two coats, nor sandals, nor staves. For the workman is worthy of his food.

entries.title: Matthew 10:11
segments: And into whatever city or village you enter, inquire who within it is worthy. And there abide until you go away from there.

entries.title: Matthew 10:12
segments: And when you come into a house, greet it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:13
segments: And if the house is worthy, let your peace come on it. But if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.

entries.title: Matthew 10:14
segments: And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

entries.title: Matthew 10:15
segments: Truly I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

entries.title: Matthew 10:16
segments: Behold, I send you out as sheep in [the] midst of wolves. Therefore be as wise as serpents and as harmless as doves.

entries.title: Matthew 10:17
segments: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to the sanhedrins, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.

entries.title: Matthew 10:18
segments: And you shall be brought before governors and kings for My sake, for a testimony against them and the nations.

entries.title: Matthew 10:19
segments: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what you shall speak; for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak.

entries.title: Matthew 10:20
segments: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

entries.title: Matthew 10:21
segments: And brother will deliver up brother to death, and [the] father [his] child. And the children shall rise up against [their] parents and cause them to be put to death.

entries.title: Matthew 10:22
segments: And you will be hated of all [men] for My name's sake, but the [one] who endures to [the] end shall be kept safe.

entries.title: Matthew 10:23
segments: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into another; for truly I say to you, In no way shall you have finished the cities of Israel until the Son of Man comes.

entries.title: Matthew 10:24
segments: A disciple is not above [his] master, nor the servant above his lord.

entries.title: Matthew 10:25
segments: It is enough for the disciple that he is like his master, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more those of his household?

entries.title: Matthew 10:26
segments: Therefore do not fear them, for there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, and nothing hidden which shall not be known.

entries.title: Matthew 10:27
segments: What I tell you in darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear, proclaim on the housetops.

entries.title: Matthew 10:28
segments: And do not fear those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. But rather fear Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

entries.title: Matthew 10:29
segments: Are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? And one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

entries.title: Matthew 10:30
segments: But even the hairs of your head are all numbered.

entries.title: Matthew 10:31
segments: Therefore do not fear, you are of more value than many sparrows.

entries.title: Matthew 10:32
segments: Then everyone who shall confess Me before men, I will confess him before My Father who is in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 10:33
segments: But whoever shall deny Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 10:34
segments: Do not think that I have come to bring peace on earth. I did not come to send peace, but a sword.

entries.title: Matthew 10:35
segments: For I have come to set a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

entries.title: Matthew 10:36
segments: And a man's foes [shall be] those of his [own] household.

entries.title: Matthew 10:37
segments: He who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me. And he who loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:38
segments: And he who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:39
segments: He who finds his life shall lose it. And he who loses his life for My sake shall find it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:40
segments: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:41
segments: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward. And he who receives a just [one] in the name of a just one will receive a just [one's] reward.

entries.title: Matthew 10:42
segments: And whoever shall give to one of these little ones a cup of cold [water] to drink, only in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, He shall in no way lose his reward.
